title: SG-5.4.3 preload.test.ts with mocked dependencies
summary: Add game/tests/preload.test.ts covering planner dedup, unknown refs, fallback key and BootScene use of both
description: Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey exist in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts and BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) uses them, but game/tests/preload.test.ts does not exist. Desired behavior: one unit test file with all dependencies mocked proves deduplication, unknown-reference reporting, fallback key resolution and BootScene use of planner and fallback. Expected result: the file exists and passes under game/vitest.config.ts. Why: locks SG-5.4 behavior against regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/tests/preload.test.ts, when vitest runs it, then all tests pass with every dependency mocked
Given two objects referencing one known asset, when planPreload runs, then the asset appears once in load
Given an unknown asset ref, when BootScene.preload runs, then it is not loaded and a warning is logged
Given an unknown id, when BootScene.resolveKey runs, then it returns fallback:missing

out_of_scope: Running Phaser, a browser or the real asset tree
preserve: Existing planPreload.test.ts, resolveTextureKey.test.ts and frontend BootScene tests

technical_constraints: Mandatory: Phaser, content, store and effect context mocked with vi.mock
Do not change vitest config unless strictly needed
